headlines: The S&P 500 fell about 0.5% today, its eighth drop in nine days.
Computer chip and AI company shares fell sharply a day after a big jump. Nvidia lost nearly 6%.
Some investors moved money into retail and health care shares. Dollar Tree and Kohl's rose after strong reports.
The Dow Jones average rose about 0.85% and closed above 50,000.
